glance: Saturday afternoon will mark the 29th meeting between Notre Dame and Boston College. The series stands with a 19-9-0 Notre Dame advantage all-time.
The Irish are 9-5-0 all-time in home games against the Eagles.
The first meeting between Notre Dame and Boston College inside Notre Dame Stadium came in 1987, when the Irish defeated the Eagles 32-25.
Notre Dame has won ten consecutive games against Boston College. The current Irish streak started in 2009, ending a six-game winning streak in the series for the Eagles, which started in 2001.
It is the second meeting between Marcus Freeman and Bill O'Brien as head coaches.
The Irish are 2-0 against the Eagles under Freeman.
